{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# Do NOT filter out -999 here, because we want to count all enrolled patients
# Even if a patient has only a -999 baseline, they were still enrolled
# So, deduplicate on the full dataset
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Count the number of unique patients
num_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Print only the number
print(num_patients)"}
